# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_WITH_VOLUME_DRY_UP

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A gap up on weak follow-through volume indicates lack of conviction and impending mean reversion. Fading the gap by shorting the break of the first 5-minute bar's low captures this edge, with the gap high as stop and prior day's close as target.

## Mechanism

Entry: If open gaps up >0.40% from prior close AND first 5-min bar volume <0.5 * average 5-min volume AND first bar close within 0.10 * ATR(14) of open, then enter short on break below first bar's low. Stop: gap high. Target: prior day's close (gap fill). If price reaches 0.5R, switch to premium-stop trailing at 0.8% of entry price. Regime: VIX 12-22, time 09:30-10:00; avoid if gap accompanied by volume >1.5 * average.
